description: This file contains utility functions for handling channel data in Mattermost, including channel info completion, sorting, filtering, and unread count calculations.

methods.name: completeDirectChannelInfo
methods.description: Completes information for a direct or group channel based on user state and channel data.

methods.name: splitRoles
methods.description: Splits a roles string into a set of individual roles.

methods.name: newCompleteDirectChannelInfo
methods.description: A variant of completeDirectChannelInfo that uses minimal data dependencies for performance.

methods.name: completeDirectChannelDisplayName
methods.description: Generates display name for direct or group channels based on user IDs.

methods.name: cleanUpUrlable
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to be URL-friendly.

methods.name: getChannelByName
methods.description: Finds a channel by name from a collection.

methods.name: getDirectChannelName
methods.description: Creates a unique name for a direct message channel based on user IDs.

methods.name: getUserIdFromChannelName
methods.description: Extracts the other user ID from a channel name.

methods.name: isDirectChannel
methods.description: Checks if a channel is a direct message channel.

methods.name: isGroupChannel
methods.description: Checks if a channel is a group message channel.

methods.name: getChannelsIdForTeam
methods.description: Retrieves all channel IDs associated with a specific team.

methods.name: getGroupDisplayNameFromUserIds
methods.description: Generates a display name for a group channel based on user IDs.

methods.name: isDefault
methods.description: Checks if a channel is the default channel.

methods.name: completeDirectGroupInfo
methods.description: Completes information for a group channel based on user state and profiles.

methods.name: isOpenChannel
methods.description: Checks if a channel is an open/public channel.

methods.name: isPrivateChannel
methods.description: Checks if a channel is a private channel.

methods.name: sortChannelsByTypeListAndDisplayName
methods.description: Sorts channels based on a list of types and display names.

methods.name: sortChannelsByTypeAndDisplayName
methods.description: Sorts channels by type and display name.

methods.name: sortChannelsByDisplayName
methods.description: Sorts channels alphabetically by display name.

methods.name: sortChannelsByDisplayNameAndMuted
methods.description: Sorts channels by display name, prioritizing unmuted channels.

methods.name: sortChannelsByRecency
methods.description: Sorts channels by most recent activity.

methods.name: isChannelMuted
methods.description: Determines if a channel is muted based on membership notify props.

methods.name: areChannelMentionsIgnored
methods.description: Checks if channel mentions are ignored based on user notification settings.

methods.name: filterChannelsMatchingTerm
methods.description: Filters channels whose name or display name starts with a search term.

methods.name: channelListToMap
methods.description: Converts a list of channels into a map keyed by channel ID.

methods.name: calculateUnreadCount
methods.description: Calculates unread message and mention counts for a channel, considering read status and urgency.
